dashboard.label: Audit Summary
dashboard.description: Executive summary of the Splunk deployment's infrastructure health and security posture: headline KPIs plus a consolidated findings checklist (OK / WARNING / CRITICAL) built from live checks against internal indexes and REST endpoints. Drill into "Infrastructure Health" and "Security Audit" for the detail behind each finding.

search.query: `audit_queue_fill` earliest=-15m | stats max(pct_full) as MaxPct | table MaxPct

[ `audit_queue_fill` earliest=-15m | stats max(pct_full) as MaxPct | eval Category="Infrastructure", Check="Indexing queues not blocked", Status=case(MaxPct>=100,"CRITICAL",MaxPct>=90,"WARNING",true(),"OK"), Detail="Max queue fill: ".round(MaxPct,1)."%" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_errors_warnings` log_level=ERROR earliest=-24h | stats count | eval Category="Infrastructure", Check="Low ERROR rate in splunkd.log (24h)", Status=case(count>=100,"CRITICAL",count>=20,"WARNING",true(),"OK"), Detail=count." ERROR events in the last 24h" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_scheduler_log` status=skipped earliest=-24h | stats count | eval Category="Infrastructure", Check="Scheduled searches not being skipped (24h)", Status=case(count>=50,"CRITICAL",count>=10,"WARNING",true(),"OK"), Detail=count." skipped search executions in the last 24h" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_indexes` | eval PctUsed=if(maxTotalDataSizeMB>0,round((currentDBSizeMB/maxTotalDataSizeMB)*100,1),0) | where PctUsed>=80 | stats count as NearMax, max(PctUsed) as MaxPct | eval Category="Infrastructure", Check="Indexes within size quota", Status=case(MaxPct>=95,"CRITICAL",NearMax>0,"WARNING",true(),"OK"), Detail=NearMax." index(es) at/above 80% of max size" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_partitions_space` | stats min(free) as MinFreeMB | appendcols [ `audit_rest_server_settings` | stats max(minFreeSpace) as MinFreeThresholdMB ] | eval Category="Infrastructure", Check="Disk space above minFreeSpace threshold", Status=case(MinFreeMB<MinFreeThresholdMB,"CRITICAL",MinFreeMB<(MinFreeThresholdMB*2),"WARNING",true(),"OK"), Detail="Lowest free space: ".round(MinFreeMB/1024,1)."GB (threshold: ".round(MinFreeThresholdMB/1024,1)."GB)" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_license_pools` | eval PctUsed=if(quota>0,round((used_bytes/quota)*100,1),0) | stats max(PctUsed) as MaxPct | eval Category="Infrastructure", Check="License usage within quota", Status=case(MaxPct>=100,"CRITICAL",MaxPct>=90,"WARNING",true(),"OK"), Detail="Highest pool usage: ".MaxPct."%" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_kvstore_status` | stats values(status) as status | eval Category="Infrastructure", Check="KV store healthy", Status=if(status="ready","OK","WARNING"), Detail="KV store status: ".status | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_server_settings` | eval enabled=if(match('enableSplunkWebSSL',"(?i)^(1|true)$"),1,0) | stats max(enabled) as enabled | eval Category="Security", Check="Splunk Web SSL enabled", Status=if(enabled=1,"OK","WARNING"), Detail=if(enabled=1,"Splunk Web is serving over HTTPS","Splunk Web is serving over plain HTTP") | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_sslconfig` | eval enabled=if(match('enableSplunkdSSL',"(?i)^(0|false)$"),0,1) | stats max(enabled) as enabled | eval Category="Security", Check="Management port (8089) SSL enabled", Status=if(enabled=1,"OK","WARNING"), Detail=if(enabled=1,"splunkd management traffic is encrypted","enableSplunkdSSL is disabled") | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_users` | search "locked-out"=1 | stats count | eval Category="Security", Check="No locked-out accounts", Status=if(count>0,"WARNING","OK"), Detail=count." account(s) currently locked out" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_login_events` info=failed earliest=-24h | stats count | eval Category="Security", Check="Failed login attempts within normal range (24h)", Status=case(count>=100,"CRITICAL",count>=20,"WARNING",true(),"OK"), Detail=count." failed login attempts in the last 24h" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_saved_searches_acl` | search "eai:acl.sharing"="global" "eai:acl.perms.write"="*" | stats count | eval Category="Security", Check="No globally shared saved searches writable by everyone", Status=if(count>0,"WARNING","OK"), Detail=count." saved search(es) shared globally with write access for everyone" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ `audit_rest_users` | search roles=admin | stats count | eval Category="Security", Check="Number of users holding the admin role kept minimal", Status=if(count>10,"WARNING","OK"), Detail=count." user(s) hold the admin role" | table Category Check Status Detail ] | append [ | rest /services/authentication/providers/LDAP splunk_server=local | eval encrypted=if(match(SSL,"(?i)^(1|true)$"),1,0) | stats count as total, sum(encrypted) as encrypted_count | eval Category="Security", Check="LDAP strategies use SSL/TLS (LDAPS)", Status=case(total=0,"OK",encrypted_count<total,"WARNING",true(),"OK"), Detail=if(total=0,"No LDAP strategy configured",(total-encrypted_count)." of ".total." LDAP strategy(ies) not using SSL/TLS") | table Category Check Status Detail ] | eval sort_rank=case(Status="CRITICAL",1,Status="WARNING",2,Status="OK",3,true(),4) | sort sort_rank, Category, Check | table Category Check Status Detail
